scope: API authorization, redaction, audit correlation, tool policy, prompt-injection labeling

contract.cross_scope: tenant and dossier mismatch are denied
contract.idempotency: (tenant_id, dossier_id, actor_id, idempotency_key) caches command decisions and rejects digest conflicts
contract.tools: read-only tools allowed; unknown and side-effect tools require a validated, scoped, expiring, one-time ApprovalGrant
contract.prompt_injection: content is labeled untrusted and never executed

verification.warning: PytestCacheWarning: .pytest_cache path was not writable on Windows

limitations: This is an in-process policy and idempotency cache; production deployment needs a shared durable cache/store.
The module does not expose HTTP routes or execute commands; callers must enforce returned decisions.
ApprovalGrant issuance/proof/consumption is process-local prototype behavior; production needs an authenticated issuer and shared durable approval ledger.
